description: Fires when the user plays a move that's IN the trap_line AND the engine likes it (cp_loss <= 20). The trap library labels the move 'victim_falls' regardless of whether the victim defends or falls in — promotion_ladder cross-references with engine eval to distinguish. Celebrates the precise play.

fact_glossary.move_san: SAN of the user's defensive move

variants.default: {move_san} — correct response in the {trap_name}. Keep playing precisely; the line isn't over.
